title: fix(console): the record header reads placedActions, so a packaged sys_user header action draws again (#29951)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4xjiquevJqfBXiUoqfQwa1)_

Fixes #29951

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：控制台的记录页头现在会读 `page:header` 的 `placedActions: true`（#30018 落地的新键），画出该对象所有放在 `record_header` / `record_more` 的动作，实时读取。用户、组织、审批请求三个平台记录页改用这个开关，去掉了 #27219 冻结的 id 列表。
- 为什么改：按你对 #29951 的裁决 A（记录 6624172200）。18.3 里别的包给 `sys_user` 加的页头动作（比如 `type: 'url'` 的链接）在设置里的用户抽屉和整页都不显示了，因为平台页面只列了自己的 id，而手写列表就是全部。
- 风险与回滚：只影响写了 `placedActions: true` 的页头，也就是这三个平台页面；原来列表里的动作都放在页头位置，所以照样显示，只是多了别的包加的。不写这个键的页面行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。按你的修订，18.3.x 不发、不写发版说明。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`（`PageHeaderActions` 读这个键）、`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`（共用的 `placedHeaderActions`，合成页头也用它）、三个页面文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.placedHeaderActions-29951.test.tsx`，预期 7 个用例全绿：抽屉和整页都画出别的包加的 url 动作，旧的冻结列表画不出来。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 不需要你操作，席位复核后走队列落地。`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` 的那条限定语是受管文件，另开一个小 PR（`Refs #29951`）给你合并。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **The header reads `placedActions: true`** (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`). `PageHeaderRenderer` hands the key to `PageHeaderActions`. `true` draws every action of the page's object whose `locations` include `record_header` or `record_more`, in declaration order, read from the object's metadata through the same `useMetadataItem('object', …)` lookup an id list uses, and through the same predicate, capability and switched-off chain after it. Omitted or `false`, an authored `actions` list is still the whole set (#11592). Only the boolean `true` opts in. A `true` beside an authored list, which the spec refuses at parse, draws none of the object's actions and is reported once with `console.error`, the same fail-closed answer a refused id array gets.
- **One placed-header reader.** `placedHeaderActions` (`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`, exported from `@object-ui/types`) is the rule: every action `actionRendersAt` places at `record_header` or `record_more`, the first of a name. `RecordDetailView`'s synthesized header (`recordHeaderActions`) now reads it instead of its inline filter, so the synthesized default page and a `placedActions: true` header draw the same set. No second reader.
- **Registration input.** The `page:header` registration declares `placedActions` (`boolean`), and `sdui.manifest.json` is regenerated (`node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, in-tree; the only component change is that input), with `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` and the component reference pages it renders (`content/docs/ui/components/page.mdx` and `index.mdx`, `node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs`).
- **The three platform pages opt in.** `sys_user_detail` and `sys_organization_detail` (`@objectstack/platform-objects`) and `sys_approval_request_detail` (`@objectstack/plugin-approvals`) set `{ type: 'page:header', properties: { placedActions: true } }` in place of the id lists #27219 froze (11 ids on `sys_user`, 4 on `sys_organization`, none on the approval request). The tab strips #27219 introduced are unchanged. Every action the old lists named was placed at `record_header` / `record_more` (the old pin held each list equal to exactly that set), so nothing the pages drew is dropped. `sys_approval_request` places no header action of its own (its decision actions are `record_section`), so its header now draws only what an installed package places there.
- **The "not drawn yet" qualifiers PR #30028 listed** (five of six; the sixth is in the skills PR):
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: the `placedActions` describe drops its `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker and the docblock says the reader is live; `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` regenerated (`gen:schema` + `gen:docs`).
  - `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`: the `_note`'s PLANNED RECORD sentence is rewritten as a LIVE RECORD that names `PageHeaderActions`, `placedHeaderActions` and the three producer pages.
  - `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS['page:header.placedActions']` struck (a strike note in its place, as the file does for `parentDataSource`).
  - `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`: the qualifier is gone.
- Changeset `.changeset/29951-page-header-placed-actions-reader.md`: patch for the six touched packages.

## Why

Ruling A on #29951 (record 6624172200). #27219 rebuilt the platform record pages as `kind: 'full'` pages with their own tab strips and copied the platform's header action ids into `page:header.actions`. Under #11592 an authored list is the whole set, so a header action any other package places on `sys_user` (or `sys_organization`, `sys_approval_request`) stopped drawing: the 18.2 slotted page's synthesized header had read the object's placed actions live. #30018 (PR #30028) declared `placedActions: true` spec first; this is its reader and its producers. The tab strips #27219 was for stay. Nothing ships in 18.3.x.

## Tests

- **Card pin** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.placedHeaderActions-29951.test.tsx`, through the real `RecordDetailView` → `page:header` → `PageHeaderActions`, on the full page (route) and the drawer (`embedded`, as `ObjectView` mounts it). A `sys_user` def carries the platform's `ban_user` (`record_header`) and `impersonate_user` (`record_more`), two actions placed elsewhere, and two packaged `type: 'url'` actions (`record_header` and `record_more`, `_packageId: 'com.qa.hdr'`).
  - Shipped header node (`placedActions: true`): the packaged `record_header` action draws inline and the `record_more` one in the ⋯ menu, beside the platform's own; the `list_toolbar` / `record_section` actions do not draw. Page and drawer.
  - Frozen #27219 header (an id list, no opt-in): neither packaged action draws. Page and drawer.
  - CONTROL on a non-platform object: `placedActions: true` draws exactly the four placed actions in declaration order; an authored `['ban_user']` without the key draws exactly `Ban User` (#11592).
  - The refused pair draws none of the object's actions and reports once.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/record-page-header-actions.test.ts` rewritten: per page, the object places header actions (non-vacuous), the header node is exactly `{ placedActions: true }`, and `ComponentPropsMap['page:header']` accepts it. `sys-approval-request-page.test.ts` pins the new node.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts`: the marker test now asserts the describe carries no `[PLANNED` marker.
- **Ablation**: the reader made to ignore the key (`const placedOptIn = false && rawPlacedActions === true;`) turns 4 of the 7 pin cases red (`Unable to find role="button" and name "Ban User"`: shipped page, shipped drawer, CONTROL placed, refused pair) and leaves the 3 list cases green. File restored byte-identical (`cmp`).

## Acceptance notes

- The ui pin mirrors the shipped header node rather than importing the page: `@objectstack/platform-objects` is not a dependency of the ui tree. The platform-objects and plugin-approvals pins hold the shipped node equal to it.
- `.changeset/30018-page-header-placed-actions.md` (PR #30028, unconsumed) still says the renderer does not read the key yet. Both changesets ride the same next release, so its CHANGELOG entry will carry that sentence beside this one. Not edited here (it is #30018's record); flagging it for the seat.
- No 18.3.x release-notes line, per the maintainer's amendment to ruling A.

## Verification

- **Live, on a dev boot** (`pnpm build` under `os-verify-lock`, 119/119; showcase backend `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 4317`; Console from `ui/` src via vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`). A writable package `com.qa.hdr` stores `hdr_user_profile` (`type: 'url'`, `record_header`, on `sys_user`) and the CONTROL `hdr_account_profile` on `showcase_account`. Served: `GET /api/v1/meta/page/sys_user_detail`, `sys_organization_detail` and `sys_approval_request_detail` each answer `kind: 'full'` with `{"type":"page:header","properties":{"placedActions":true}}`; `/meta/object/sys_user` serves `hdr_user_profile`. Playwright readings:
  - Setup → Users, full page: row Update Profile · Ban User · Set Password · Edit · ⋯; ⋯ = Refresh · Impersonate User · Set Manager · Change Password · Change Email · **QA User Profile** · Add to favorites · Share · Delete My Account.
  - Setup → Users, drawer: the same row; ⋯ = Impersonate User · Set Manager · Change Password · Change Email · **QA User Profile** · Add to favorites · Share · Open as full page · Delete My Account. The tab strip (Details · Positions · Permission Sets · Business Units · Sessions …) is unchanged.
  - Before the fix (round 1, main `6a4737ab`), both readings were the same lists without QA User Profile. CONTROL `showcase_account`, full page and drawer: QA Account Profile · Edit · ⋯, as before.
- **ui suites** from the `ui/` root: the new pin 7/7; `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header*`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.*`, `packages/types/src/__tests__` and the console parity test: 518 files, 11620 tests green; `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` alone: 261 green with the exemption struck.
- **Package suites**: `@objectstack/platform-objects` `src/pages` 46, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` `sys-approval-request-page.test.ts` 20, `@objectstack/spec` `src/ui/component.test.ts` 361, all green.
- **Type-check**: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (`type-check`, from the ui root), `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` (`typecheck`), `@objectstack/spec` `tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- **Generated**: `gen:schema` + `gen:docs` (reference), `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (manifest + record), `node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs` (`content/docs/ui/components/`); `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `pnpm check:sdui-reference` green.
- **Gates**: every line of `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the final diff (119), then `--ran`: 119 derived, 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. 118 exit 0. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 on an absent `assertProtocolCompat` anchor in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (`areas/platform-core.json`); it is red the same way on merge base `d79eecfe5b` and on `origin/main` `f35b361997`, outside this diff. Three first-pass reds were re-run: `pnpm check:sdui-reference` was this diff's own (component pages regenerated and committed, then green); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (one 15 s timeout under load) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` (`check:test-typecheck`'s tsc ran out of heap because this container's `NODE_OPTIONS` carries no heap flag) were green re-run alone under the lock, the second with `--max-old-space-size=4096` appended.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (The changed TypeScript files pass eslint with 0 errors: the seven under `packages/` with the root config and `--no-inline-config`, the six under `ui/` from the ui root. CI's `pnpm lint` covers the full tree.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the `## 维护者速读` block, which is written in Chinese for the maintainer.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
